items: An omnidirectional lamp: `w` watts-ish (intensity), `r` the metres it reaches, `col` its colour. The record is a 0.12 m marker centred on the light itself; the real light follows it every frame.

A downlight aimed 2 m along its own -Y, so rx/rz tilt the beam. `angle` is the cone HALF-angle in degrees, `pen` the soft edge 0-1. Photometric ▸ IES replaces angle and flux with a measured luminaire's.
A softbox `x` by `z` metres facing the floor — a light shelf, a coffer, a window as a light source.
